issues.on_page: Intermediate Sources 9,901 = entirely 2110 County Fines and Licenses 9,901 (p8; county treasurer schedule p20 'Fines and Licenses')
issues.issue: The rules say code 2110 (county fines and license fees passed to schools) is 'fines and forfeitures', and a broad statement line takes the category of what it holds. detail[13] already uses fines and forfeitures, so the statement line contradicts its own detail.

issues.extracted: no decision_needed entry; recorded in report_discrepancies only
issues.on_page: Depreciation 'Transfers from General Fund' 100,000 (p12) and Employee Benefit 'Transfer from General Fund' 100,000 (p13), but the General Fund shows only 35,000 transferred out (p6, p10: 8000 Transfers 35,000, to Activities p14)
issues.issue: This is a one-sided transfer of 200,000: governmental transfers net to +200,000 instead of zero. Under the rules, a person needs to settle where this money came from.

The printed net figure is recorded as transfers_in, and transfers_out is null. Gross figures would be 235,000 in and 35,000 out (p6, p7); those aren't printed as totals. The identity holds either way.

issues.issue: The residual 39 is 38 of interest plus 1 of rounding. It could be investment income rather than taxes (unlabeled).
